ops.sql: SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name AS Iface, p.OperationID, p.Name, p.ea_guid FROM t_operation p INNER JOIN t_object o ON p.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE o.Package_ID = 1127 AND o.Object_Type = 'Interface' ORDER BY o.Object_ID, p.Pos, p.OperationID
SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name, o.Package_ID, t.Value FROM t_object o INNER JOIN t_objectproperties t ON t.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE t.Property = '505-1 Operation Link' AND o.Package_ID >= 1124
SELECT Package_ID, Name, Parent_ID, ea_guid FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1128, 1129, 1130, 1131, 1136) OR Package_ID >= 1153
SELECT Package_ID, Name, ea_guid FROM t_package WHERE Package_ID IN (1059, 1060)

SELECT Object_ID, Name, Object_Type, Package_ID FROM t_object WHERE ea_guid IN ('{9D3D6D34-DDDB-4ac6-87D8-1B7938C65F8C}','{73A46459-E3D6-4413-BEE8-557E45E17F1A}','{800A1529-918A-4dd8-8CDA-E65504A3420C}','{ECFCBB28-C4EC-40f3-9CD7-2AF4F87244C0}')

SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Object_Type, o.Classifier, c.Name AS ClassifierName, o.ParentID, o.Package_ID FROM t_object o LEFT JOIN t_object c ON c.Object_ID = o.Classifier WHERE o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1132 AND 1135 AND o.Object_Type IN ('Object','Component','InteractionOccurrence','MessageEndpoint')
SELECT Object_ID, Name, Notes FROM t_object WHERE Object_ID = 11950
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Package_ID >= 1124 AND Package_ID <= 1160
